title: Falcon motion publishes ALERT while still moving and occupies the handler queue
description:
After an accepted MD move and settle delay falcon_move sets ALERT, then FD progress updates publish it while FR can still report moving. The synchronous polling loop holds the queue for up to120s, delaying queued disconnect; asynchronous abort flag remains serviced. Keep BUSY until bounded finalizer completion and preserve abort/disconnect ownership; add healthy-progress/timeout/disconnect cases. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
